job.domain: an HR and finance helpdesk assistant

items.text: Due to urgent repairs to the water main on Floor 3, the gym and showers will be closed today from 2pm. We expect to reopen tomorrow morning; please check the facilities page before you travel.
Reminder: the deadline to submit expense claims for the charity fun run is Friday 14 March. Late claims cannot be processed, so please get yours in before 5pm.

The finance team has been trialling an automated assistant to answer common questions about expense policies. It can look up limits, check receipt requirements and point you to the right form, but it cannot approve claims or make payments. Early feedback has been positive, though a few people noted the assistant sometimes misses context in longer email threads. If you use it, please review its suggestions before submitting anything. The trial runs until the end of the quarter, and we'll decide then whether to keep it.
Your gym membership renewal is due on 1 April. To continue without interruption, update your payment details in the benefits portal by 28 March.
The charity bake sale raised £840 for the local food bank. Thank you to everyone who baked, bought or donated—especially those who stayed late to help clean up.
If your subscription renewal fails because your card has expired, the system will email you a secure link to update it. No action is needed until you receive that email.

We've had several questions about the new fitness benefit, so here's a quick summary.

The benefit gives you up to £40 per month towards a gym, pool or sports club membership. You pay the provider directly, then claim the cost back through the expenses system under the category 'Health & Wellbeing'. Claims are usually processed within five working days.

A few people have asked whether the automated assistant in the expenses portal can check eligibility. It can confirm the general rules, but it can't see your specific membership details, so please read the policy page first. If you're still unsure, contact the benefits team.

Finally, a reminder that the charity 10k takes place on 18 May. Entry is free for staff, and all sponsorship money goes to the company's chosen charity. If you'd like to take part, sign up on the intranet by the end of the month.
Please note: the gym will be closed on Saturday 5 April for essential maintenance. We apologise for any inconvenience and will reopen as normal on Sunday.

The subscription renewal for the team's project management software is coming up next month. The finance team has already approved the budget, so no further sign-off is needed. If you have questions about the renewal, contact the IT service desk. They also have a chatbot on their homepage that can answer common queries about software licences.

Our annual charity quiz night is back on 22 November at the Riverside Hall. Tickets are £10 per person, including a buffet, and all proceeds go to the children's hospice. Teams can have up to six people; if you don't have a full team, we'll match you up on the night. To reserve a table, email socialcommittee@northbridge.co.uk with your team name and number of players. Payment can be made in cash on the door or via the JustGiving page linked on the intranet. We're also looking for raffle prizes, so if you or a local business can donate something, please get in touch.
